name: hex_impact
for: hexer hex: hit on the hero (or on a raised shield)
notes: The curse clamps on: a pale flash, seven uneven violet tendrils lash out from the hit point, then hook their tips and clench back into a knot (grasping fingers), a ring of five runes settles over it and crumbles away in blocks; motes scatter and fall. Anchor = hit point. 10 frames @10 fps.
